sources.title: LeRobot - Ben Stirling
sources.snippet: 2025-06-15 LeRobot I took a break from robotics after a machine learning project on semantic navigation. I was at a Christmas party and heard about an open-source initiative for 6 DoF robotic arms called LeRobot. There were even pre-arranged Bambu 3D printing files available, so I printed the SO-100 and got to assembling it as soon as my motors arrived.
